title: Refund policy
content: We offer refunds within 14 days of purchase for monthly subscriptions. For yearly plans, prorated refunds may apply.

title: Duplicate charge
content: If a customer is charged twice, verify transaction IDs and issue a refund for the duplicate charge after confirmation.

title: App not loading
content: If the app fails to load, ask the user to clear app cache and restart the device. Collect logs if problem persists.

title: Password reset
content: Users can reset passwords using the 'Forgot password' link. If email not received, check spam and verify user email.

title: API rate limit
content: If customers see rate-limit errors, suggest increasing plan or implementing exponential backoff retries.

title: Invoice request
content: Provide invoices via the billing portal. For manual invoice requests, collect billing contact and company details.

title: Delete account
content: Account deletion requires email verification and confirmation. Backup data before deletion if requested.

title: Feature not working
content: Gather reproduction steps, browser/device, and console logs. Try to reproduce on staging.

title: Sales inquiry
content: For pricing and enterprise inquiries, route to sales team and collect company size and use case.

title: Refund timeline
content: Refunds typically show in 5-7 business days depending on bank processing times.
